project: Autonomous AI Video Editor for Insta360 Tracking

target_workstation.cpu: Intel Core Ultra 9 285H (with native NPU integration)
target_workstation.gpu: Intel Arc 140T GPU (48GB Allocatable Shared VRAM)

components.VideoPairParser: Dual-track synchronization indexing .lrv proxy paths to .insv master clips.
components.FrameBufferIngestor: High-capacity RAM frame caching downsampled to 640x480 matrices.
components.TelemetryExtractor: Structural IMU data mapping matrix template framework.

components.OpenVINO_Compiler: YOLOv10m.pt neural graph trimmed and quantized to a 29.9MB FP16 compiled IR topology.
components.IntegratedPerceptionEngine: Hybrid tracking engine integrating YOLOv10 for candidate discovery with SAM 2 pixel-exact tracking masks.

targets: Translate 2D bounding boxes into spherical target coordinates (Yaw and Pitch angular ray streams).
Implement discrete Kalman Filtering loop equations to strip away visual jitter and handle subject occlusion.
Upgrade TelemetryExtractor with an subprocess-level binary reader to capture real camera motion profiles.
Implement digital 2nd-order High-Pass Filter at 150Hz to eliminate high-intensity wind buffeting noise.
Integrate dynamic range limiting compression curves to prevent high-amplitude audio clipping peaks.
Compile the real-time parallel FFmpeg hardware encoding pipeline using Intel QuickSync Video (QSV) parameters.
